_doc: Họa Tinh Đường signature items (rules-proposals R7; design/items record). Unpriced proposals; modifier sizes follow the wood, water and general catalogues' grade 3-4 items. Prefix ht-.

items.name: The Silver Candle (Ngân Chúc Đăng)

effects.name: Autumn Light on the Screen (Thu Quang Họa Bình)
effects.rule: While the candle is lit, the first talisman you throw at each foe is painted twice: it strikes again a moment later at half strength. Talismans you paint by its light keep a grade higher.

items.lore: A tall candlestick of silver with a white pine-wax candle that is never allowed to burn down, after the line of Đỗ Mục's that the head is named for: a silver candle, autumn light, a cold painted screen. Every Dipper talisman the Pivot has bought since 912 was painted by its light.
items.build_use: The head's lamp: talisman damage and speed, and a second stroke.

items.name: Dipper Talisman Seal (Bắc Đẩu Phù Ấn)
items.lore: The seal stamped in the corner of every talisman the Hall sells, seven dots and a handle cut in boxwood. Whoever holds it is the Hall's chief painter. Kỷ Ngân Chúc gave it to Lạc Tố Bình in 1170.
items.build_use: The chief painter's seal: faster talismans.

items.name: Gourd of Rainfast Ink (Bất Tẩy Mặc Hồ)
items.lore: The Hall's rain-fast ink, Mặc Yên soot made fast by the Hall's own writ, kept in a black gourd; once dry, it does not run in rain or blood.
items.build_use: Marks that last: Water behind the Wood talismans.

sets.name: Candle and Ink (Chúc Mặc Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Seven Stars in One Stroke (Nhất Bút Thất Tinh): every seventh talisman you throw at one foe closes the Dipper: it strikes once more for each of your Wood stacks on that foe and spends them, and your marks on that foe cannot be cleansed for 8 s.

sets.story: The founder's candle and the ink gourd Kỷ Ngân Chúc made when she took the hall in 1137. The candle stays in the hall; she carries it out only to fight, and the hall does not like it. She wears them beside the Talisman-Bearer's Ring.
